who_we_are.heading: Built for buyers who order by the carton, not the piece.
body: Since 2019 Grade has supplied quality goods to businesses across Bangladesh, sourcing direct from manufacturers and cutting out the intermediaries that inflate prices. Over 300 work orders completed for more than 50 companies.
This site covers the stationery range: pens, exercise books, school supplies, office consumables and filing — supplied to schools, retailers and corporate procurement teams by the carton.

image.alt: Warehouse racking stacked with palletised cartons

categories_intro.heading: Five ranges, supplied by the carton.

pillars_intro.heading: How we keep your supply predictable.

pillars.title: Direct sourcing
pillars.body: We buy straight from the manufacturer and cut the intermediaries out of the chain, so a quote reflects the goods rather than the layers above them.

pillars.title: One-stop supply
pillars.body: Pens, exercise books, school supplies, office consumables and filing on a single order and a single invoice, instead of five separate suppliers.

pillars.title: Consistent specification
pillars.body: Repeat orders match the last one. Stock is held against agreed lines, so a reorder does not turn into a renegotiation.

pillars.title: Delivery on schedule
pillars.body: Dispatched from Dhanmondi to schools, retailers and corporate buyers across Bangladesh, on the date agreed.

clients_intro.heading: Trusted by schools, retailers and corporate buyers.
